### Production Standard Checklist
Please ensure your contribution meets the OpsVault Enterprise Standards:
- [ ] Bash scripts include `set -euo pipefail` and clean error exit traps.
- [ ] Destructive actions support `--dry-run` or `-n`.
- [ ] Includes clean structured logging (`[INFO]`, `[WARN]`, `[ERROR]`).
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets or environment credentials.
- [ ] Includes a dedicated `README.md` explaining tools, line-by-line guide, and a safe Docker test command.
- [ ] Passes ShellCheck / Flake8 linting.
